### <span class="method-badge" data-method="POST">POST</span> `/access/ticket`

```ts
proxmox.access.ticket.$post()
```

Create or verify authentication ticket.

Returns `object`.

::: warning
Not callable with an API token.
:::

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `new-format` | boolean |  | This parameter is now ignored and assumed to be 1. — default `1` |
| `otp` | string |  | One-time password for Two-factor authentication. |
| `password` | string | yes | The secret password. This can also be a valid ticket. |
| `path` | string |  | Verify ticket, and check if user have access 'privs' on 'path' — ≤ 64 chars |
| `privs` | string |  | Verify ticket, and check if user have access 'privs' on 'path' — format `pve-priv-list`, ≤ 64 chars |
| `realm` | string |  | You can optionally pass the realm using this parameter. Normally the realm is simply added to the username &lt;username&gt;@&lt;realm&gt;. — format `pve-realm`, ≤ 32 chars |
| `tfa-challenge` | string |  | The signed TFA challenge string the user wants to respond to. |
| `username` | string | yes | User name — ≤ 64 chars |
